meta.name: parallel-feature-development
meta.description: Coordinate parallel feature development with file ownership strategies, conflict avoidance rules, and integration patterns for multi-agent implementation. Use this skill when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when two or more agents need to implement different layers of the same system simultaneously, when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts in a shared codebase, when designing interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against each other's APIs before they are ready, or when deciding whether to use vertical slices versus horizontal layers for a full-stack feature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大型功能拆成小块，多团队同时开发互不干扰
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要多人同时开发一个功能的不同部分
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel development of large features without conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team develops different parts of a feature concurrently

howto.what: Claude 会引导你规划多智能体并行开发：把大功能拆成几个独立任务，给每个智能体分配专属文件（一个文件只归一个人改），并给出接口约定、集成方式（垂直切片/水平层/混合）和分支管理建议。
howto.when: 当你说要把一个大功能拆成多个独立任务交给不同智能体并行开发、要给各智能体划定专属文件以避免冲突，或需要设计接口契约与集成模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我把登录功能拆成两条并行任务，并给每个智能体分配专属文件。
say.note: Claude 会给出任务拆分和文件所有权方案。

say.text: 并行开发的双方要对接 API，先立一个接口契约文件怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会指导创建由专人维护的接口契约文件。

say.text: 这个全栈功能按垂直切片还是水平层拆给多个智能体？
say.note: Claude 会对比两种集成方式并给出适用建议。

howto.what_en: Claude plans multi-agent parallel development: decomposes a large feature into independent tasks, assigns exclusive file ownership to each agent (one file per owner), and recommends interface contracts, integration style (vertical slice/horizontal layer/hybrid), and branch management.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to split a large feature into independent parallel tasks for multiple agents, assign file ownership to prevent conflicts, or design interface contracts and integration patterns.

say_en.text: Split login into two parallel tasks with dedicated files per agent.
say_en.note: Claude returns a task split and file ownership plan.

say_en.text: Let's define an interface contract before two agents integrate APIs in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude advises a contract file owned by one person.

say_en.text: Should this full-stack feature use vertical slices or horizontal layers?
say_en.note: Claude compares both patterns and recommends one.
